title: Discounted returns with episode ends
summary: Reward-to-go returns for one episode and for a batch of joined episodes with done flags, plus return normalization.

mutants.discount_includes_reward: Computes G = gamma * (r + G), so the reward of the current step is also discounted.
mutants.forward_sum: Sums the discounted rewards from the start of the episode, not from step t to the end.
mutants.no_epsilon: Divides by the standard deviation without 1e-8, so equal returns give NaN.
mutants.no_reset_at_done: Ignores the done flags, so the return of one episode includes rewards of the next episode.
mutants.reset_after_add: Resets the return after it stores the done step, so the reset cuts the wrong episode.
mutants.sample_std: Uses the sample standard deviation (ddof = 1), not the population standard deviation.
